Speak to an Engineer View Our Services Market Leading, Customer Driven Services Building Performance. Delivered. We’re an industry leading provider of HVAC, water management and renewables solutions. Founded in 2008 in Glasgow, Scotland with nationwide coverage, our dedicated team of engineering and renewables specialists have the experience and knowledge to deliver tailored solutions to meet businesses specific requirements. Why Clients Choose Protech Whether you’re managing rising energy costs, ageing plant, compliance obligations, or net-zero targets, we provide the expertise and practical solutions needed to keep your buildings safe, efficient, and future-ready. Our approach is simple: understand your challenges, identify opportunities for improvement, and deliver solutions that create measurable value throughout the life of your assets. Our Commitment to Your Success Four principles that shape every decision we make. Safety First Every project, every visit. Our engineers are trained, accredited and work to rigorous HSEQ standards. Risk assessments, method statements and safe systems of work are non- negotiable. Learn more about our safety standards Engineering Lead Every scope of work, maintenance schedule and project recommendation starts with a technical assessment of what the building actually needs. We do not upsell. We do not propose work without clear technical justification. Compliance Built In Whether we are servicing a gas-fired boiler, commissioning a chiller or carrying out a legionella risk assessment, statutory and regulatory compliance is embedded in the method, the documentation and the sign-off. Proof Over Promises Reduction in reactive callouts. Improvement in asset availability. Demonstrable compliance at audit. Lower total cost of ownership. If we cannot evidence the outcome, we have not delivered. Proactive Partnership Every engagement follows the same structured process, whether it is a maintenance agreement, a capital project or a water services programme. 1 Survey On-site inspection. Our engineers survey assets, review documentation and understand operational priorities. No desktop assumptions. 2 Plan Tailored scope of work with clear options, transparent pricing and honest recommendations based on what we find. 3 Deliver Directly employed engineers carry out the work to the relevant standard. Get in touch Frequently asked questions We work as principal contractor or specialist subcontractor, depending on the project. Since 2008, we have delivered projects across the UK, from single boiler swaps to multi-million pound plant room rebuilds. Expertise That Keeps Your Operations Moving These are the situations that bring most clients to us. If any of them describe what you are dealing with, the conversation usually starts with a site assessment. Ageing or Inefficient Plant Repair costs climbing, efficiency falling. Time to weigh up a planned replacement against another year of patching. Change of Use Original systems designed for a time gone by and needs have since changed. Rising Energy Costs Older plant is burning more energy than it should. The payback maths on a modern system finally adds up. Decarbonisation Net Zero commitments, MCP deadlines and tenant pressure are forcing a shift away from gas. Compliance Change F-Gas phase-down, the 2030 MCP deadline or a Building Safety Act review has put existing plant on borrowed time. Capability That Drives Project Success Heating, cooling, controls and everything in between. Here is what our project teams deliver. Heating Upgrades Commercial boiler replacements, cascade systems, plate heat exchangers and distribution upgrades. Gas, LPG, oil or electric, across any commercial building type. Cooling & AC Projects Commercial AC installation across chillers, VRF and VRV systems, split systems and close-control cooling. From a single commercial AC unit installation in a server room through to building-wide cooling for process-critical areas. Low Carbon and Heat Pumps Air source and ground source heat pump installations, including hybrid systems that pair heat pumps with your existing gas plant for phased decarbonisation. Plant Room Refurbishment Full plant room strip-out and rebuild, covering primary and secondary pipework, pumps, pressurisation units, expansion vessels, controls and insulation.
